Objective: - A Full Stack Developer for IT Cell of the National Disaster Res ponse Force (NDRF) will capable to provide strategic, deployment, and ma intenance of secure, scalable, and responsive web and mobile application s. These tools will be integral to disaster response coordination, data visua lization, incident reporting, and communication systems used by NDRF. 02. Education Qualifications: BE/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology or MCA / or equivalent degree from a recognized University or Institution. 03. Work Experience: a. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a Full Stack Developer. b. Proven experience in developing responsive web and mobile applic ations. C. Experience of previous working of the bidder with NDRF/Central Gov ernment by the vendor. 4. Technical Skills: a. Front-End: i. Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. ii. Experience with at least one modern framework such as React. js / Angular / Vue.js for developing responsive web interfaces. b. Back-End: i. Experience in server-side development using ASP.NET. ii. Ability to design and develop REST ful APIs for web applicatio ns. c. Database: Working knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server / MyS QL / Postgre SQL. d. DevOps/Tools: i. Familiarity with Git-based version control systems. ii. Basic understanding of Docker and CI/CD concepts. iii. Experience in deployment and hosting of applications on clou d platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP etc) or on premise servers. E. Security & Compliance: Understanding of secure coding practices, data protection, and role-b ased access control (RBAC). 05. Scope of work:- The Full Stack Developer will be responsible for: a. System Design & software Development: - Develop and maintain fresh web/mobile applications as per requirement of NDRF HQ. b. Compliance of security audit : - Making the developed applications cyber security audit compliant as per CERT-in guidelines. c. API & Backend Integration:- i. Build secure APIs to support mobile apps, dashboards, and third-party integrations. ii. Work with backend services to ensure reliable data handlin g and retrieval. d. Database Management:- Design and develop suitable database optimized for NDRF applications. e. Maintenance & Support:- i. Monitor application performance, troubleshoot issues, and

apply updates in in-house developed applications. ii. Ensure scalability and disaster-resilience in the deployment architecture. f. Provide support for programming, maintenance, troubleshooting and t echnical support for in-house developed existing four web applications of NDRF developed on following programming platform- i. Front end- ASP.Net ii. Data base- SQL g. Provide technical opinion in projection of user requirements of NDRF t o the agencies(NIC, DoPT, BISAG-N etc) whose applications are being u sed in NDRF h. Documentation & Handover i. Provide full technical documentation, user manuals, and tra ining to NDRF personnel. ii. Ensure code is version-controlled and accessible for future maintenance. 6. Other Competencies: a. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. b. Effective communication and coordination abilities. c. Willingness to work in a disciplined and emergency service environ ment. d. Readiness to travel to NDRF battalions/field units when required. 7. Integrity Clause: a. The candidate must not have been blacklisted or debarred by any government or public sector organization. b. Should provide a declaration regarding no pending criminal or vigil ance case. 8. Engagement Type and Duration: a. The consultancy shall be on a contractual basis initially for 1 Year, f urther extendable based on performance and organizational require ments. 9. Working location would be at HQ NDRF, NDCC -II Building, Jai Singh Roa d, New Delhi-110001. 10. Suitable replacement should be provided during long term leave of the programmer. 11. Evaluation Criteria: - Evaluation Parameter Weightage Relevant Experience 35 % Technical Skill Proficiency 35 % Sample Work/Portfolio & intervie 30 % w
